delivery: Complete buildings only, one .vox per treatment; no cell files or brushes.

families.title: Blue house
families.drawn: Six copies of the blue-roofed house, four of them in two pairs side by side, the right one a tile further back: a front gable of dark timber with two small windows, two chimneys, a blue door, a double window over flower boxes.

families.title: Domed centre
families.drawn: The building in the middle: the red dome of a Poke Ball (its band and button, as drawn) on a blue-panelled building with white walls, purple-blue windows, a glass double door under a dark blue canopy, banded wooden pillars at its corners.

families.title: Round shop
families.drawn: The round-cornered building by the pond: a low salmon-tiled roof, white panels in grey frames, a red band between its two storeys, a glass door, windows over planters of pink flowers.

families.title: Teal hall
families.drawn: The teal building at the bottom right, its left third in view (the rest off the image or behind trees): a hipped teal roof in a brown parapet with a beige top, a white strip of windows over a beige band, a teal ground storey, a lower teal wing. Completed mirrored.
